teams.notes: Winnipeg won back-to-back Grey Cups in 2019 and 2021 (no 2020 season due to COVID). Since the 2021 title they have reached three straight Grey Cup Finals (2022, 2023, 2024), losing all three. In 2025 they slipped to 4th in the West (10-8), crossed over into the East bracket under the CFL crossover rule, and lost the East Division Semi-Final to Montreal. In 2026 they crossed over again at 9-9, won the East Semi-Final in Toronto and lost the East Final in Montreal. Score = 16*3 + 8*1 + 4*1 = 60.

Drought window is 3 completed seasons (2024-2026). 2024: lost to Toronto Argonauts in East Final (Division Final, one round before the Grey Cup = semis). 2025: lost to Saskatchewan Roughriders 25-17 in the 112th Grey Cup = finals loss. 2026: finished 14-4, beat Winnipeg 33-23 in the East Final, then lost the 113th Grey Cup 37-30 to Edmonton = a second straight finals loss.

teams.notes: Calgary won 8 Grey Cups total (1948, 1971, 1992, 1998, 2001, 2008, 2014, 2018). Since the 2018 title, they have exited in the West Semi-Final (first playoff round) five times in six playoff appearances. In 2024 they missed the playoffs entirely with a losing record, and in 2026 they missed again at 9-9. The PPI score is 4*5 = 20.
